violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside prep coolers need cleaned of debris.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Ice cream condiments drawers need cleaned of debris.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying.
